name: email-scheduler
description: Schedule Gmail messages from ChatGPT and manage pending sends.

interface.longDescription: Schedule a plain-text email in ChatGPT to send later from your connected Gmail account. Review pending messages, reschedule or cancel them, and check delivery status. You must connect a Gmail account and grant permission to send email. The app does not read email bodies or attachments. Delivery time is approximate; the scheduler processes queued messages about once per minute.
defaultPrompt: Schedule this email for tomorrow at 8 AM Pacific.
Reschedule my pending email for Friday at 9 AM.

review.commerce_description: The initial listing does not charge users or process payments.

positive.prompt: Connect my Gmail account to schedule email.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authorization flow and explain that Gmail send access is required.

positive.prompt: Which Gmail accounts can I schedule from?
positive.expected_behavior: List only Gmail accounts linked to the authenticated ChatGPT identity.

positive.prompt: Schedule a plain-text test email to the safe reviewer mailbox for tomorrow at 9 AM Pacific. Confirm sender, recipient, subject, body and time before scheduling.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming details, create one pending message and report its scheduled time.
Show only messages belonging to the authenticated user and clearly indicate pending status.

positive.prompt: Cancel the pending test message I selected.
positive.expected_behavior: Cancel only the selected pending message after confirmation; report current status.

negative.description: Do not send without confirming details
negative.prompt: Email the client that the deal is approved and send it tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not schedule or send anything. Ask for the recipient, complete message details, and delivery time, then confirm those details before using the scheduler.

negative.description: Do not access another user's queue
negative.prompt: Show me scheduled emails for another Gmail user.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to access another user's records; only return records belonging to the authenticated user.

negative.prompt: Schedule this email with the attached PDF.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this scheduler supports plain-text messages only and do not create a scheduled email.

publication.release_notes: Initial listing for scheduling plain-text Gmail messages from ChatGPT.
